address: 18401 Collins Ave, Sunny Isles Beach, FL
amenitiesDescription:
Over 20,000 sq ft of amenity space, curated by Bentley's design team and furnished with Bentley Home collection.

Arrival & Dining

Three-story ocean-view lobby. Proper English by Todd English — a residents-only restaurant concept by the four-time James Beard Award-winning chef, his first private restaurant. Mezzanine Lounge and Whiskey Bar (Bentley matrix grille–inspired). Cigar Lounge.

Entertainment

14-seat private cinema (Bentley motorcar–inspired). Game Room: golf simulators, racing simulators, VR. Kid's Club. Pet Spa.

Wellness

Fitness center with ocean-view outdoor terrace. Men's and women's dressing rooms: steam, sauna, lockers. Full-service spa with couples and individual treatment rooms; in-residence spa on demand.

Pool & Beach

Heated oceanfront pool with spa, cabanas, F&B service. 200 ft of private shoreline with beach attendants, chaises, umbrellas. Oceanfront beauty salon.

Services

24-hour valet, multilingual concierge, restaurant and yacht reservations, lifestyle and health concierge.

investmentIntelligence.thesis: Dezer Development's track record is the most relevant comparable: Porsche Design Tower, launched in 2012 at ~$1,400/sqft, traded above $3,000/sqft at resale. Bentley Residences extends that playbook with a first-in-class automotive brand, the Dezervator sky-garage, and a 216-unit canvas. At 716 feet and 62 stories, it will be the tallest residential tower on a U.S. beachfront upon its 2028 delivery — a distinction that supports long-term resale demand.

investmentThesis: At 716 feet, Bentley Residences is the tallest residential tower on any U.S. beachfront, backed by a $630M construction loan and Florida Green Building Council certification. Construction went vertical in June 2026 and has reached approximately 13 stories as of late July, advancing at roughly one floor every five to six working days. The foundation pour (a 36-hour, 20,000-cubic-yard operation by Coastal Construction) was the largest residential construction pour in Florida and the second-largest in U.S. history. The Dezervator™ vehicle elevator system is a genuine engineering innovation that exists nowhere else in the world, and the brand collaboration is the first ground-up residential project in Bentley's history. Dezer Development controls 200 feet of Sunny Isles Beach oceanfront at 18401 Collins Avenue, with Aventura Mall, Bal Harbour Shops, and both MIA and FLL airports within reach. Completion 2028.
name: Bentley Residences
rentalPolicy: Min 6-month lease, 2x per year. No short-term.
residenceContent:
The world's first Bentley-branded residential building, with no more than four homes per floor. Arrival is via the glass-enclosed Dezervator™ — a patented vehicular elevator system with four robotic car lifts that delivers you and your cars directly to your private sky garage, accommodating three to four vehicles per residence.

ViewsAtlantic & Intracoastal
Ceilings10 ft Smooth-Finish
KitchensMiele full suite
Smart HomeCrestron + Savant

Residences are delivered fully finished with diamond-pattern oolite stone flooring, custom Italian-designed cabinetry, Miele full kitchen suites, primary bathrooms with soaking tubs, custom vanities and private sauna rooms, motorized blackout shades, and private elevator landings. Every home includes dual laundry, two hot water heaters, and a dedicated A/V closet. The cylindrical glass facade maximizes ocean exposure while the Dezervator delivers residents and their vehicles to sky garages with three to four car capacity per residence.
